AUTHOR: Nabi
TITLE: Probabilistic Model-Based Active Learning with Attention Mechanism for Fish Species Recognition
REGION: Gulf of Mexico continental shelf, Brownsville TX to Dry Tortugas FL, USA
DATA: SEAMAPD21 (SEAMAP reef fish video survey), 28,328 annotated images extracted from video
V_EV: Related Works: 'This dataset introduces several challenges, including multiple fish in a single image, low-light images due to underwater conditions, occlusions'; depths 15 m to 200 m
D_EV: Section III Dataset: 'we divided the dataset into training, validation, and testing sets in a ratio of 70:15:15, respectively.'
R_EV: Abstract: 'This study uses the Southeast Area Monitoring and Assessment Program Dataset 2021 (SEAMAPD21).' Only this dataset is evaluated
C_EV: Methodology: 'This method uses a scoring function that aggregates the aleatoric uncertainties and epistemic uncertainties to measure the informativeness of an image.'
E_EV: Table I / Table II report only mAP (%) for supervised and active-learning models
ARCH: SSD300/SSD512 with VGG16 backbone, Gaussian-mixture (mixture density network) localization and classification heads, CBAM attention, deep active learning (Choi et al. 2021)
METR: mAP (%) per active-learning cycle and input resolution
NOTE: Conference paper (OCEANS). Split: the authors re-split SEAMAPD21 images 70/15/15 themselves (dataset has a predefined image-level split, but the paper does not say it used it); frames extracted from the same survey videos, so leakage across split is possible and not discussed. C3 = 기타 because the detector outputs GMM-based aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty; however this uncertainty is used only for active-learning sample selection and is never evaluated as calibration of final detections, so C_ALL = Y is mechanical and a verifier may downgrade. No confidence threshold stated. Visibility only as qualitative 'low-light' description; depth range 15-200 m given for the survey (V2 = Y). PLAT: SEAMAP stationary camera arrays; paper does not mention bait. ENV coded 산호초 for 'reef fish video survey' (Gulf of Mexico hard-bottom reefs, not strictly coral). PRE not stated (VGG16 typically ImageNet-initialised). | POLICY: decision 3 — GMM uncertainty used only for active-learning sample selection, never evaluated; not counted as C3. No threshold reported → NR.
